## smoke_bugs

```yaml
- id: dynamics_step_shape_mismatch
  status: seed
  description: dynamics.step returns a state with the wrong rank or dimension count.
- id: collision_check_too_strict
  status: seed
  description: The collision model rejects every candidate state or edge.
- id: planner_no_path_found
  status: seed
  description: The planner exhausts its time/iteration budget and returns no path.
- id: state_bounds_violation
  status: seed
  description: Sampled or propagated states escape the environment state bounds.
- id: control_dim_mismatch
  status: seed
  description: The planner samples controls whose dimension does not match the dynamics.
- id: empty_tree_after_iteration_cap
  status: seed
  description: The RRT tree keeps only the start node after every extension is rejected.
- id: motion_primitive_translation_invariance_violated
  status: seed
  description: Motion primitives are translated in dimensions where the dynamics are
    not translation-invariant.
- id: trajectory_optimization_diverges
  status: seed
  description: A hybrid post-optimization phase diverges from the search warm start.
```

## semantic_checks

```yaml
- id: MP-analyzer-family-classified
  stage: stage_1_analyzer
  check: 'The spec identifies the algorithmic family: sampling-based, search-based,

    '
  silent_failure: A hybrid planner is flattened into a generic plan(...) call and
    the wrong phases are generated.
  severity: warning
  status: seed

  stage: stage_1_analyzer
  check: System dynamics, state dimension, control dimension, and collision model
    are captured as method-critical context.
  silent_failure: The generated planner uses point-mass or straight-line dynamics
    while the paper requires kinodynamic planning.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: MP-arch-dynamics-match-paper
  stage: stage_2b_architecture
  check: The dynamics step and, when needed, step Jacobian match the paper's system
    model.
  silent_failure: The planner runs on a substitute dynamics model and silently changes
    the feasible set.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: MP-arch-collision-check
  stage: stage_2b_architecture
  check: Collision checking matches the environment geometry and state coordinate
    frame.
  silent_failure: Every sample is accepted or rejected due to coordinate-frame drift.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: MP-method-pluggable-does-planning
  stage: stage_2c_method
  check: The pluggable planner actually performs the paper's planning/control algorithm,
    not a straight-line or random fallback.
  silent_failure: The notebook visualizes a trajectory while the paper's planner logic
    is absent.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: MP-method-termination-and-seeds
  stage: stage_2c_method
  check: Termination conditions, time/iteration budgets, and random seeds match the
    paper or are explicitly smoke-scaled.
  silent_failure: Planner success/failure depends on unseeded randomness or hidden
    budget changes.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: MP-params-scale-honesty
  stage: stage_2x_params
  check: Planning-time, node-count, primitive-count, and optimization-iteration reductions
    are disclosed as smoke-scale choices.
  silent_failure: A smoke budget is presented as paper-scale planning performance.
  severity: warning
  status: seed
- id: MP-notebook-dynamic-scenario
  stage: stage_3a_notebook
  check: Dynamic-obstacle claims are exercised with obstacle state that actually changes
    during the demo.
  silent_failure: A dynamic-obstacle paper is demonstrated on a static scene.
  severity: error
  status: seed
  probe: motion_planning.scenario_dynamics
- id: MP-notebook-steering-responsive
  stage: stage_3a_notebook
  check: The executed planner's first decision responds to goal direction on both
    left and right cases.
  silent_failure: Steering is an arbitrary tie-break even though the plot appears
    plausible.
  severity: warning
  status: seed
  probe: motion_planning.steering_responsiveness
- id: MP-notebook-goal-progress
  stage: stage_3a_notebook
  check: On an obstacle-free fixture, the planner ends closer to the goal than it
    started.
  silent_failure: The planner reports success without making goal-directed progress.
  severity: error
  status: seed
  probe: motion_planning.goal_progress
- id: MP-seed-cost-terms
  stage: stage_2c_method
  check: All cost terms contribute (no single term dominates trivially).
  silent_failure: One weight dwarfs the rest; the planner ignores most objectives.
  severity: warning
  status: seed
- id: MP-seed-kinematics
  stage: stage_3a_notebook
  check: Output trajectory respects kinematic limits and is forward-in-time.
  silent_failure: Trajectory teleports or violates velocity/accel bounds.
  severity: error
  status: seed
- id: MP-sampling-goal-bias
  stage: stage_2c_method
  check: The goal-bias hyperparameter matches the paper and is actually used during

  silent_failure: A high or ignored goal bias collapses exploration while easy demos

  status: seed
- id: MP-sampling-full-dynamics-extend
  stage: stage_2c_method
  check: Tree extension uses the paper's full system dynamics, not linear interpolation

- id: MP-sampling-nearest-metric
  stage: stage_2c_method
  check: Nearest-neighbor metric and weights match the paper's state-space convention.

  check: Motion-primitive libraries cover the state space when the paper relies on

  status: seed
- id: MP-sampling-trajectory-optimization-phase
  stage: stage_2c_method
  check: Hybrid iDb-family methods implement the trajectory optimization phase that

  silent_failure: The implementation reports the search output as final dynamically

  severity: error

- id: MP-sampling-tree-visualized
  stage: stage_3a_notebook
  check: The notebook visualizes tree growth when the method is sampling-based.
```

## pluggable_component

```yaml
name: plan
return_type: PlanResult
signature_template: plan(start, goal, environment, dynamics, seed, *paradigm_extras_by_name)
  -> PlanResult
contract:
  fixed_positional_args:
  - start
  - goal
  - environment
  - dynamics
  seed_param: seed
  paradigm_extras_forwarding: by_name_from_config
  forbidden_param_names:
  - config
return_type_definition: 'PlanResult is a dataclass / namedtuple with fields:

  - trajectory: Trajectory | None

  - status: Literal["success", "timeout", "infeasible", "error"]

  - stats: Dict[str, Any]

  '
rationale: 'The notebook calls the planner on a concrete start/goal/environment

  problem and visualizes the returned trajectory when status is success.

  Method-specific hyperparameters are forwarded by name from params.

  '
```

```yaml
description: Sampling-based motion-planning package ownership.
files:
- path: method/data.py
  kind: paradigm_fixed
  produced_by: package_scaffolder

    kind: function
    signature: 'load_environment(name: str = ''two_rooms_simple'', *, seed: int =
      0) -> Environment'
  - name: load_problem
    kind: function
    signature: 'load_problem(name: str = ''two_rooms_simple'', *, seed: int = 0) ->
      Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, Environment]'
- path: method/example_data/README.md
  kind: paradigm_fixed
  produced_by: package_scaffolder
- path: method/model.py
  kind: paradigm_shaped
  produced_by: architecture_coder
  public_symbols:
  - name: <SystemDynamics>
    kind: class
    required_methods:
    - 'step(self, state: Tensor, control: Tensor, dt: float) -> Tensor'
    - 'step_jacobian(self, state: Tensor, control: Tensor, dt: float) -> Tuple[Tensor,
      Tensor]'
  - name: <CollisionModel>
    kind: class
    required_methods:
    - 'is_in_collision(self, state: Tensor) -> bool'
    - 'distance_to_obstacle(self, state: Tensor) -> float'
- path: method/training.py
  kind: paradigm_fixed
  produced_by: architecture_coder
  public_symbols:
  - name: precompute_motion_primitives
    kind: function
    signature: 'precompute_motion_primitives(dynamics: <SystemDynamics>, *, n_primitives:
      int = 100, seed: int = 0) -> List[MotionPrimitive]'
- path: method/method.py
  kind: method_shaped
  produced_by: method_coder
  public_symbols:
  - name: plan
    kind: function
    signature: plan(start, goal, environment, dynamics, seed, *paradigm_extras_by_name)
      -> PlanResult
    contract:
      fixed_positional_args:
      - start
      - goal
      - environment
      - dynamics
      seed_param: seed
      paradigm_extras_forwarding: by_name_from_config
      forbidden_param_names:
      - config
  - name: <method_helpers>
    kind: function
    all_top_level_functions_are_public: true
- path: method/__init__.py
  kind: derived
  produced_by: init_finalizer
- path: requirements.txt
  kind: derived
  produced_by: init_finalizer
- path: method/README.md
  kind: paradigm_fixed
  produced_by: package_scaffolder
dependency_graph:
  method/data.py: []
  method/model.py: []
  method/method.py:
  - method/model.py
  method/training.py:
  - method/model.py
  method/__init__.py:
  - method/data.py
  - method/method.py
  - method/model.py
  - method/training.py
validators:
  after_package_scaffolder: scripts/validate_scaffolder_output.py
  after_architecture_coder: scripts/validate_architecture_coder_output.py
  after_method_coder: scripts/validate_method_coder_output.py
  after_init_finalizer:

  - scripts/validate_arch_contract_runtime.py
```

```yaml
required_blocks:
  data_loader.load_data_returns:
    type: dict[str, shape_string]
  architecture.dynamics:
    required_subblocks:
    - class_name
    - forward.input
  architecture.collision_model:
    required_subblocks:
    - class_name
    - forward.input
  pluggable_component.name:
    must_equal: pluggable_component.name
  pluggable_component.input_shapes:
    type: dict[str, shape_string]
  pluggable_component.output_shape:
    type: shape_string
symbol_conventions:
  state_dim: dimension of the state vector
  control_dim: dimension of the control input
  B: runtime batch size when dynamics are vectorized
```
